about.title: About SAIN
about.historyText1: Founded in 1991, SAIN (Integrated Agricultural Solidarity) has been based in Kakanitchoé village, 12 km from Adjohoun in Benin, since 1998. The farm spans 14 hectares, including highlands and lowland crops.
about.historyText2: Our farm has thrived for over 30 years through a deeply rooted approach in values of solidarity, respect for nature, and community development.
about.missionText: Promote sustainable agricultural and food systems to feed and provide dignified livelihoods for populations, particularly youth and women.
about.visionText: A better world where people live with dignity in a healthy environment.
about.philosophyText: Communion between Man, Nature and the Community.
about.valuesSubtitle: The pillars on which our daily commitment is based
